""Why are you so polite with me, always saying 'Yes, sir,' and 'That's right, sir,' but never doing a thing I tell you? These words I speak to you are not mere additions to your life, homeowner improvements to your standard of living. They are foundation words, words to build a life on."
‭‭Luke‬ ‭6:46-47‬ ‭MSG‬‬‬‬‬‬

Are you a sinner? I know I am. At least, in my head I believe the word of God which says we are all sinners and fall short of His glory (Rom 3:23). But every day, in my heart, I struggle with the idea that I am basically a good person. I just need to fix a few things about myself and I'll be OK. I am not OK. I don't need renovations. I need to be demolished and rebuilt from the ground up. I need Jesus, not just as my Savior, but as my Lord. O Lord, thank You for Your grace and mercy that sent Jesus to die for my sins. Now, by the power of Your Spirit, make Jesus lord of my heart. Amen.

-Sean Lennon
Interview Text:
Tesfaye Gadisa Ejeta 
Prophecy
Interview (part 2)

Another story. Another village. There was a person who had been in prison for 9 years for killing someone and after he was released he was now in the village. 
While I was ministering with people in a house I heard a voice outside the door. I heard someone screaming outside. They opened the door and the man from prison came in. While he was coming into the room the people in the congregation got up and tried to move him out because he was coming to beat me up. I told them, "Don't." I asked him, "Why have you come? If you have come to listen, please sit down and you will learn how to make your life better." The man reached to hit me with a stick. I said, "In the name of Jesus Christ" and the man's hand got stuck out straight. 
Until I finished my preaching his arm was frozen, held out.
Here Tesfaye lets himself start to really smile for the first time. 
As soon as I finished my preaching I prayed for the congregation and the Holy Spirit told me to forgive this person. 
Tesfaye reaches his hand out from his side, and he looks in that direction as if he were speaking to the man.
So I walked to him and gave thanks to the Lord. I praised the Lord and said, "I have forgiven this person." Immediately he started to put his arm down toward his body and he asked, "What did you do to me?" 
So I asked God why this thing happened. But the Holy Spirit spoke and told me, "Now his family members will come to you and will know Jesus."
That prison man's mom got sick and the hospital couldn't heal her. Finally someone told them to take the woman to me. I prayed for her and now she is a leader of women in my church. Three weeks ago that prison person came to me and got saved.
Music Video Instructions: Be grateful for God for such beauty in this world.
